name: oh_my_god_particle

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Greisen-Zatsepin-Kuzmin (GZK) cutoff and the cosmic microwave background radiation field that bounds ultra-high-energy cosmic ray propagation

⊢.justification: Void state before the Fly's Eye detector registers any particle; no event exists in the data stream

⊣.justification: The 1991 observation that closes the system — the terminal anchor containing the entire OMG particle domain

≻.justification: Forward morphism of the proton traversing ~100 Mpc through CMB and magnetic fields toward Earth

≺.justification: Reverse morphism — the proton's energy cascades downward through atmospheric depth (X_max) toward ground

⋈.justification: Composition of successive interaction lengths and shower development stages into a continuous trajectory

⊙.justification: Self-reference — the proton's stable baryon number and mass persist through all transformations

∈.justification: Splits the propagating proton into two arms: pion-production (GZK) interaction vs. direct atmospheric collision

∋.justification: Rejoins the fork arms into the single detected extensive air shower recorded by fluorescence telescopes

⊤.justification: Affirmative state — fluorescence yield reconstructs energy > 10^20 eV with ~30% resolution

⊥.justification: Negative state — no astrophysical source found within the GZK horizon for the reconstructed arrival direction

⊞.justification: Paradice — the particle simultaneously violates the GZK cutoff (impossible) and is detected (observed), held without resolution

⊡.justification: Permanent irreversible record — the raw ADC counts, timestamp, and geometry frozen in the experiment archive

split_outputs: pion-production arm (Δ⁺ resonance with CMB photon)
direct-collision arm (hadronic interaction with atmospheric nucleus)
phase_2.fuse_result: detected extensive air shower with reconstructed energy exceeding GZK cutoff
phase_2.failure_reason: FSPLIT3 at step 5 dangles — no matching FFUSE3

phase_3.void_description: Pre-detection state; no particle registered in the detector, empty data buffer
phase_3.true_description: Particle detected with measured energy ~3×10^20 eV, shower profile consistent with proton primary
phase_3.false_description: Particle not detected, or energy reconstructed below GZK threshold, or event rejected as background
phase_3.both_description: The paradoxical state where a particle exceeds the GZK cutoff yet is detected — both 'kinematically forbidden' and 'experimentally observed' held simultaneously

phase_5.compiler_frontend: Standard Model particle physics + general relativity + detector simulation (CORSIKA, AIRES)
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Electromagnetic and strong interactions mediating proton-photon/nucleus collisions; fluorescence photon transport to mirrors
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Fly's Eye detector electronics (PMTs, FADCs) + data acquisition system + magnetic tape archive + published literature
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Cosmic ray arrival times (stochastic Poisson process) + detector trigger logic (3-fold coincidence) + analysis pipeline stages
phase_5.alfs_store: Fly's Eye experiment logbook / PDG cosmic ray database / UHECR event catalog

phase_6.cycle_cost: ~3×10^20 eV per event (particle rest energy + kinetic) + detector operating energy (~kW-years)
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Quiet detector, isotropic CMB bath at 2.7 K, no event in buffer
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Recorded shower profile, energy deposit in atmosphere, permanent entry in scientific record
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The particle's energy dissipates into the extensive air shower (heat, ionization, secondary particles); the information gain (detection of a super-GZK event) balances the thermodynamic cost, preserving the paradox as a conserved quantity in the scientific record
